main_text.l: Obumbrari : Profundum petere : Tinnire, Palpitare. Niphal נִצַּל Tinnire. Hiphil הִצִּיל Umbram facere : Tinnire.
צלצל m. Umbra densa : item Fuscina.
צַלְצַל m. Siderutio, Rubigo : vel Locusta, Vermes.
צַלְמָוֶת f. umbra lethalis: ex צַל & מָוֶת.
צֶלַע צלע c. Costa, Latus : Claudicatio : Substructio, Trabs substructionis : Cella, Cubiculum laterale : Tabula, Contabulatio : plur. צְלָעוֹת & צְלָעִים.
צֹלֵעַ m. Claudicans; Claudus. f. צוֹלְעָה.
צָמֵא Sitire : Sitiens, Sitibundus : plural. צְמֵאִים. Fem. צְמֵאָה.
צָמֵאוֹן צְמָאוֹן m. צְמָאָה f. Sitis.

page.notes: Several Hebrew vowel points and some entries in the faded upper and left areas are uncertain; the Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible. The catchword is at the bottom right.
